spans.s: गौतम m. 1. A name of the sage Bharadvāja; 2. a name of Śatānanda, Gotama’s son; 3. a name of Kṛpa, Droṇa’s brother-in-law; 4. a name of Buddha; 5. name of the propounded of the Nyāya system of philosophy.
गौतमी f. 1. Name of Kṛpī, wife of Droṇa; 2. an epithet of the Godāvarī; 3. the teaching of Buddha; 4. the Nyāya system of philosophy propounded by Gautama.
